The caller (BFF) presents EITHER its workload certificate (the
`bff-delegator` identity - the TLS layer CA-verifies and injects the
subject; the boot-loaded registry map grants `sentin8:delegate:read`,
auth DESIGN §4.3f; group DESIGN.md §3.1) OR a valid M2M Bearer token
with `sentin8:delegate:read` scope. A cert-bound M2M token keeps its
`cnf` propagated to the delegated token so it inherits the binding.

so knowledge of a user_code alone can no longer mint tokens for an
arbitrary user.

This endpoint is called by the Auth Flutter consent page (served on the
provider's auth domain, e.g. `auth.ibank.local`) to fetch the customer's
accounts at this Data Provider. The accounts are displayed with
checkboxes so the customer can select which ones to share (FDX UX
Guidelines "Select Accounts").

Auth looks up consent data providers from the `sentin8_consent_providers`
table (populated at runtime by `sentin8-cli vertical enroll`). For each
provider, auth mints a short-lived JWT with the registered scope and
calls the registered service via its platform domain URL.
No vertical service URLs, paths, or scopes are hardcoded in auth.
Handle consent accounts.

factor identifier.

pending_token_id.description:
For sign-in MFA verification: the pending session token id returned
by `POST /v1/sign-in` when MFA is required.
pending token identifier.

session_cookie.description:
When verifying during sign-in: a new active session cookie value.
The session cookie.

nonce.description:
The nonce from the authorization request.
The nonce.

client_id.description:
The OAuth client starting the sign-in (bound into the issued code).
client identifier.

nonce.description:
OIDC nonce for the downstream ID token (optional at wallet sign-in).
The nonce.

qr_data.description: The `openid4vp://` deep link for QR rendering.

issuer.description: The wallet issuer / presentation endpoint base.

presentation_definition.description: The presentation definition the wallet must satisfy.

vp_formats_supported.description: The verifiable-presentation formats this issuer accepts.

WidgetButton.description: A button (submit, cancel, row action, or link).

endpoint.description:
Endpoint to POST to (for action buttons, relative to `/v1/admin/`).
Endpoint to POST to (for action buttons, relative to `/v1/admin/`).

route.description: Route to navigate to (for link buttons). Supports `{param}` substitution.

WidgetCard.description: A glass card panel with optional title and children.

actions.description: Buttons rendered in the card footer/header.

WidgetChart.description: A simple chart backed by a data endpoint.

data_endpoint.description: Endpoint that returns the chart series data.

WidgetContainer.description: A scrollable container with layout direction and padding.

children.description:
Child widgets.

`no_recursion` keeps the derive from forwarding the reference
collection back into [`RemoteWidget`]'s manual `ToSchema::schemas` -
recursion terminates at the `$ref` (see the RemoteWidget schema impl).

WidgetDataTable.description: A data table with server-side rows, sorting, filtering, and pagination.

data_endpoint.description:
The data endpoint to fetch rows (relative to the service's `/v1/admin/` prefix).
E.g. `"/accounts"` → `GET /v1/admin/accounts`.

empty_message.description: Message shown when there are no rows.

row_actions.description: Per-row action buttons. Each button's route/endpoint supports `{row.id}` substitution.

row_link.description: Optional row click action - navigates to this route with `{row.id}` substitution.

WidgetForm.description: A form with fields and a submit action.

submit_endpoint.description:
The endpoint to POST the form data to (relative to `/v1/admin/`).
E.g. `"/accounts"` → `POST /v1/admin/accounts`.

help_text.description: Helper text shown below the field.

key.description: Field key in the submitted payload.

placeholder.description: Hint shown inside the empty field.

required.description: Whether submission fails without a value.

oneOf.description:
Conditional visibility: only show this field when another field
matches a value. Example: `{"field": "auth_mode", "equals": "staff"}`

WidgetNative.description: A native widget host - the dash renders a built-in Flutter widget.

data_endpoint.description: The data endpoint the native widget calls.

props.description: Props passed to the native widget (service-specific).

widget_name.description:
The native widget name the dash recognizes.
Built-in hosts: `posting_console`, `payment_simulator`, `workflow_visualizer`.

WidgetText.description: A text label with optional styling.
